_comment: Detail tiers and the metric lists of satk.style.profile / asset.check / style.card.
The SA look is described (docs/agent/style); the numbers here are vanilla REFERENCE: what the peer set measures,
never a target, a gate or a warning. Triangle counts in particular have no band in any tier: richer detail in the
same style is welcome. vanilla = for replacements that must sit unnoticed next to vanilla; sa_plus = default for
new assets: the same visual language at a free detail level. A tier changes only texture sizes and density
(sa_plus rules below: uv.texel_px_m) and the style descriptors in 'notes'.
Rule forms (relative to the vanilla peer set): band [lo, hi] absolute; mul [a, b] x p50; hi_mul x -> [p10, x * p90].
Lists: profile = what style.profile shows; reference = the reference rows of asset.check; anchors = sizes in wheel

vanilla.what: replacements that must sit unnoticed next to vanilla: vanilla texture sizes and texel density

sa_plus.what: default for new assets: the vanilla visual language at a free detail level (more modelled detail in the same style is welcome); larger textures where they help

fence.what: Spread of the reference numbers (style.build --validate, style.card): p10 - max(k*(p50 - p10), min_rel*|p50|) .. p90 + max(k*(p90 - p50), min_rel*|p50|); a peer set of fewer than borrow_below models takes borrow x the margins of its parent. Information only.

notes.vehicle: sa_plus keeps the shared vehicle.txd textures, key colours and lamp codes, paint on vehiclegrunge256 with UV2 for the sheen, the shading rule (hard on seams, soft corners), DXT1/DXT3 with one mip level, scale from the wheel, frames and dummies, LOD and collision. Own TXD: up to 4 textures, interior 128-256, wheel 64-128, soft and photo-like. Detail (interior, engine bay, lamp housings) is free in the same style.
notes.map: sa_plus keeps tiling textures, prelight with warm nights, draw distance <= 300 for HD models with collision and a vanilla-like LOD. Texture side <= 512 (256 typical), up to 2x the vanilla texel density.
notes.ped: sa_plus: 256x512 textures, the same 32-bone skeleton, one material; detail free in the same style.
notes.weapon: sa_plus: 128 px textures, up to 2x the vanilla texel density; detail free in the same style.
notes.upgrade: sa_plus: parts keep the vanilla frame names (ug_*).
